engineeringSkip.reason: Claiming matter can be precipitated from vacuum energy via Casimir manipulation has no basis in known physics — quantum fluctuations cannot be harvested as a net energy or material source.

factCheck.reason: The quantum vacuum's zero-point energy cannot be tapped to create matter or power — it is the lowest-energy state of space, so no device can extract net energy or material from it without violating thermodynamics.
